commands.name: sounds
commands.description: Sound packs for the moments that need you: /sounds to see every moment and command, /sounds <pack>, /sounds <moment> <pack>, test
commands.output:
This terminal: terran
This project: none (/sounds project <pack> to give it one)
New terminals: terran
Sound: on, always, quiet 23:00 to 07:00 off, a prompt sound every prompt
Moments (what plays when):
  ordered: you send a prompt (every prompt) → terran (2 clips, random)
  needsYou: Claude waits for your OK or answer → terran (2 clips, random)
  longDone: a turn of 60 s or more finishes → terran
  subagentStart: a subagent starts → aoe (2 clips, random)
  subagent: a subagent finishes → terran (2 clips, random)
  failed: a test, build or lint fails → terran (2 clips, random)
  pushed: git push goes through → terran
  compacted: the conversation is compacted → terran (2 clips, random)
  mcp: an MCP tool runs (at most every 5 minutes) → off
Commands (<moment> is one of: ordered, needsyou, longdone, subagentstart, subagent, failed, pushed, compacted, mcp):
  /sounds <pack>: switch this terminal to a pack
  /sounds default <pack>: every terminal, open or new, plays this pack (project packs stay)
  /sounds project <pack>: every terminal in this folder plays this pack, now and later
  /sounds project off: this folder goes back to the default
  /sounds project clear: remove every project pack, in every folder
  /sounds project: this project's pack and every project pack
  /sounds <moment> <pack>: one moment plays another pack, e.g. /sounds pushed aoe-turk
  /sounds <moment> <pack> <clip>: always the same clip, e.g. /sounds pushed aoe-turk allah-allah
  /sounds <moment> <pack> <pack>: mix two packs' clips for that moment
  /sounds <moment> random: a random pack each time
  /sounds <moment> off: silence one moment
  /sounds <moment> reset: back to the usual (the terminal pack)
  /sounds <moment>: list the clips that moment can play
  /sounds test [pack] [moment]: play a pack, or one moment of it, once
  /sounds off: mute
  /sounds on: unmute
  /sounds away: play only while no terminal or editor is in front
  /sounds always: play whatever is in front
  /sounds night on: qui

toasts: Sounds: terran pack. Type /sounds for the others
